headline: PRINTERS UNIONISE
ticker: FAX MACHINE STILL NOT TAKEN SERIOUSLY BY ANYONE
MANAGEMENT RESPONDS WITH MANDATORY RESILIENCE WORKSHOP
SHREDDER DECLINES TO COMMENT, SHREDS COMMENT

beats.text: Good evening! I'm Brock Stetson Jr., and THIS... is Broken News!
And I'm Philippa Featherstonehaugh. Tonight: the nation's office printers have formed a union.
Thank you, Philippa Feather-Stone-Hog. Their first demand: no more Mondays.
It's Fanshaw, Brock. It has been Fanshaw for six years. I made you a laminated card.
I keep it in my wallet! Anyway, the printers say they've been at PC LOAD LETTER since 1998.
Quick weather break! Paper jams moving in from the west. I've named the front Brenda. Brenda is upset.
Dusty, we are mid-story. And Brock, you've been reading off my autocue.
YOUR autocue? I bought that autocue. With my Emmy money.
You have a regional Emmy. For Best Hair. Which, to be fair, it is.
Philippa. That's the nicest thing you've ever... GROUP HUG!

realStory.text: Nothing, yet: this is the pilot, made up to test the studio. Office printers have not unionised. They are, however, still jammed.

signoff: Brock would like it on the record that Philippa's hair is also very good.
